cases.prompt: Write the Azure DevOps YAML for web-shell: build the image once, promote it to staging and then to production with an approval in between, and give us a way back.
Our ADO project has two approvers configured on the production environment, but releases are going out without anyone approving anything. The deploy runs in a job called deploy_prod.
Our Azure Data Factory pipeline re-reads the whole orders table every night and the Trusted layer load takes four hours. Make the copy activity incremental on the watermark column.
We deploy to an Azure Container App. If the new revision is bad, what does rolling back actually restore, and what does it not?
The rollback stage has condition: eq('$(Build.Reason)', 'Manual') and it has never once run, including during last Tuesday's incident.
Production needs one extra flag on the deploy, so I'm adding templates/deploy-prod.yml next to deploy-stage.yml and pointing the production stage at it.
